(-तं) 1 An element; five Bhūtas are enumerated: earth, fire, water, air, and Ākāśa or æther. 2 (In law,) Fact, matter of fact, the real state of the case, or what has actually been. E. भू to be, aff. क्त of the participle past.
भूतकेश: भूतकेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Root of sweet flag. E. भूत a spirit, and केश hair.
भूतक्रान्ति: भूतक्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Possession by evil spirits. E. भूत a goblin, क्रान्ति going.
भूतगण: भूतगण m. (-णः) A class of sprites or goblins. E. भूत, and गण a troop.
भूतगन्धा: भूतगन्धा f. (-न्धा) Murā, a sort of perfume. E. भूत a goblin, and गन्ध a perfume; used perhaps in the ceremonies with which those beings are worshipped.
भूतग्राम: भूतग्राम m. (-मः) Any aggregate of elementary matter, the body, the world. E. भूत, and ग्राम a heap.
भूतघ्न: भूतघ्न m. (-घ्नः) 1 A camel. 2 Garlic. f. (-घ्नी) 1 A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī 2 Holy basil. E. भूत a sprite, and घ्न what destroys or removes.
भूतजटा: भूतजटा f. (-टा) Indian spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) E. भूत a goblin, and जटा clustered locks.
भूतदया: भूतदया f. (-या) Compassion or tenderness to all creatures. E. भूत, and दया clemency.
भूतधात्री: भूतधात्री f. (-त्री) The earth. E. भूत a living being, and धात्री a nurse.
भूतनाथ: भूतनाथ m. (-थः) ŚIVA. E. भूत a spirit or element, and नाथ lord.
भूतनायिका: भूतनायिका f. (-का) DURGĀ. E. भूत a spirit, and नायिका leader.
भूतनाशन: भूतनाशन m. (-नः) 1 Marking-nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.) 2 Mustard. n. (-नं) The Eleocarpus seed. E. भूत a goblin, and नाशन dispelling.
भूतपुष्प: भूतपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. भूत a sprite, पुष्प a flower.
भूतपूर्णिमा: भूतपूर्णिमा f. (-मा) Day of full moon in Aśvin. E. भूत a sprite, and पूर्णिमा full moon: the Bhūtas being worshipped.
भूतबलि: भूतबलि f. (-लिः) Throwing the remnants of an offering on the ground for animals or outcastes, &c. E. भूत, and बलि an offering.
भूतभर्तृ: भूतभर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Supporting the elements, living beings, &c. E. भूत, and भर्त्तृ who cherishes.
भूतभर्त्तृ: भूतभर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Supporting the elements, living beings, &c. E. भूत, and भर्त्तृ who cherishes.
भूतभाव: भूतभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Elementary. E. भूत, and भाव nature.
भूतभृत्: भूतभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Supporting the elements, living beings, &c. E. भूत, and भृत् sustaining.
भूतमात्र: भूतमात्र nf. (-त्रं-त्रा) The rudiment of an element. E. भूत, and मात्र element.
भूतयज्ञ: भूतयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) 1 Offering viands, &c. to all created beings. 2 Worshipping evil spirits. E. भूत, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
भूतल: भूतल n. (-लं) The earth, the face of the earth. E. भू, and तल below.
भूतवत्: भूतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Being, been. E. भू to be, क्तवतु aff.
भूतवास: भूतवास m. (-सः) Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.) E. भूत a goblin, and वास abode.
भूतविक्रिया: भूतविक्रिया f. (-या) Epilepsy, possession by evil spirits. E. भूत, and विक्रिया change.
भूतवेशी: भूतवेशी f. (-शी) A species of the Nebāri, (Nyctanthes tristis,) with white flowers. E. भूत a goblin, विश to pervade, अण् and ङीप् aff.
भूतवृक्ष: भूतवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A tree, (Trophis aspera.) 2 A species of Bignonia, (B. Indica.) E. भूत a goblin, and वृक्ष a tree.
भूतसंसार: भूतसंसार m. (-रः) The world of mortals. E. भूत a sentient being, and संसार world.
भूतसर्ग: भूतसर्ग m. (-र्गः) Elementary nature. E. भूत, and सर्ग nature.
भूतसञ्चार: भूतसञ्चार m. (-रः) Possession by evil spirits. f. (-री) Fire in a forest. E. भूत a goblin, सम् with चर to go, aff. घञ्; also f. (-रिणी.)
भूतसम्पृक्त: भूतसम्पृक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्त) Combined with elementary matter. E. भूत, and सम्पृक्त united.
भूतसम्प्लव: भूतसम्प्लव m. (-वः) A deluge, a drowning of the world. E. भूत all beings, and सम्प्लव swimming, floating.
भूतस्थ: भूतस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Residing or existing in the elements. E. भूत, and स्थ what stays.
भूतात्मन्: भूतात्मन् m. (-त्मा) 1 The body. 2 BRAHMĀ. 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 War, conflict. 5 The elementary or vital principle, or the proximate cause of life and action. E. भूत an element, आत्मन् self or soul.
भूतादि: भूतादि m. (-दिः) God, the originator of beings. E. भूत, and आदि first.
भूतारि: भूतारि m. (-रिः) Asafœtida. E. भूत, and अरि a foe.
भूतार्त: भूतार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Possessed by an evil spirit. E. भूत a spirit, आर्त्त pained.
भूतार्त्त: भूतार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Possessed by an evil spirit. E. भूत a spirit, आर्त्त pained.
भूतावास: भूतावास m. (-सः) The body. E. भत, and आवास abode.
भूताविष्ट: भूताविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Occupied or possessed by a devil. E. भूत a spirit, आविष्ट entered.
भूतावेश: भूतावेश m. (-शः) Possession by a devil or evil spirit. E. भूत a goblin, and आवेश entrance.
भूति: भूति f. (-तिः) 1 Power, dignity. 2 Superhuman power, as attributable to ŚIVA especially, and attainable by the practice of austere and magical rites. 3 Prosperity, success. 4 Production, birth. 5 Ashes. 6 Fried meat. 7 The rut of elephants. 8 State of being, &c. E. भू to be, aff. क्तिच्.
भूतिक: भूतिक m. (-कं) 1 A sort of gentian, (G. cherayta.) 2 A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schœnanthus.) 3 Another kind of grass. 4 A medicinal plant, commonly Kayaphal. 5 Ligusticum ajwaen. E. भूत being or spirit, &c. aff. ठक्; also भूतीक.
भूतिकाम: भूतिकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Desirous of wealth, aggrandisement, &c. m. (-मः) 1 A king's counsellor, a minister of state. 2 VṚHASPATI. E. भूति, and काम who desires.
भूतिकील: भूतिकील m. (-लः) 1 A moat, a ditch. 2 A celler, a place under ground for concealing wealth, &c.
भूतिकृत्य: भूतिकृत्य n. (-त्यं) Any ceremony of a festive character, as a marriage, &c. E. भूति, and कृत्य rite; also भूतिकर्म्म, &c.
भूतिगर्भ: भूतिगर्भ m. (-र्भः) BHAVABHŪTI, the dramatic poet. E. भूति superhuman power, and गर्भ embryo, being resuscitated by his contemporary, and rival KĀLIDĀSA, after having lost his life in an intrigue.
भूतिनिधान: भूतिनिधान n. (-नं) The twenty-fourth lunar mansion, Dhaniṣṭhā. E. भूति prosperity, and निधान receptacle.
भूतीक: भूतीक m. (-कं) 1 A sort of gentian. 2 A kind of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen.) 2 A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.) 4 Another sort of grass. E. भूत being, aff. ईकक्, otherwise भूतिक.
भूतेज्य: भूतेज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) A worshipper of spirits. E. भूत, and इज्या worship.
भूतेश: भूतेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. भूत an imp, ईश lord.
भूतोपहत: भूतोपहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Possessed by an evil spirit. E. भूत, and उपहत affected.
भूत्तम: भूत्तम n. (-मं) Gold. E. भू earth, उत्तभ best.
भूत्वा: भूत्वा ind. Having been or become. E. भू to be, क्त्वा aff.
भूदार: भूदार m. (-रः) A hog. E. भू earth, दृ to tear, aff. अण्.
भूदेव: भूदेव m. (-वः) A Brahman. E. भू the earth, and देव a divinity.
भूधन: भूधन m. (-नः) A king. E. भू the earth, and धन wealth.
भूधर: भूधर m. (-रः) 1 A mountain. 2 A kind of chemical or medicinal apparatus; a sand bath in which a covered crucible is placed, and the fire is lighted above as well as below it. E. भू earth, धृ to support, aff. अप्.
भूध्र: भूध्र m. (-ध्रः) A mountain. E. भू the earth, धृ to hold, aff. अप्, and the vowel changed to its analogous semivowel.
भूनाग: भूनाग m. (-गः) An earth-worm. E. भू the earth, and नाग a snake.
भूनिम्ब: भूनिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A species of gentian, commonly Cherayta, (Gentiana cherayta, Rox.) E. भू the earth, and निम्ब the Nimb tree.
भूनेतृ: भूनेतृ m. (-ता) A king, a sovereign. E. भू the earth, and नेतृ a leader.
भूप: भूप m. (-पः) A sovereign, a prince, a king. E. भू the earth, पा to cherish, aff. क.
भूपति: भूपति m. (-तिः) A king, a sovereign. E. भू the earth, and पति master.
भूपद: भूपद m. (-दः) A tree. f. (-दी) Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac). E. भू the earth, and पद foot, root.
भूपरिधि: भूपरिधि m. (-धिः) 1 The equinoctial line. 2 The circumference of the earth. E. भू, and परिधि a circle.
भूपाल: भूपाल m. (-लः) A king, a sovereign. E. भू the earth, and पाल who cherishes.
भूपुत्त्री: भूपुत्त्री f. (-त्त्री) SĪTĀ, the wife of RĀMA. E. भू the earth, and पुत्त्री a daughter; being turned up out of the soil by a plough.
भूभुज्: भूभुज् m. (-भुक्) A king, a sovereign. E. भू the earth, भुज् to enjoy, aff. क्विप्.
भूभृत्: भूभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 A king, a sovereign. 2 A mountain. E. भू the earth, भृत् sustaining.
भूमन्: भूमन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) Much, many. E. भू for बहु many, इमनिच् aff.
भूमय: भूमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or consisting of earth. f. (-यी) A name of Chāyā or shadow personified, the wife of the sun. E. भू earth, and मयट् aff.
भूमि: भूमि f. (-मिः-मी) 1 The earth. 2 Place, site in general. 3 The base of any figure in geometry. E. भू to be, and मि Uṇādi aff.
भूमिका: भूमिका f. (-का) 1 Theatrical dress, the costume of any character, represented on the stage. 2 Decorating images, temples, gateways, &c. E. भूमि place of being, and कन् aff.
भूमिचम्पक: भूमिचम्पक m. (-कः) A plant, (Kæmpferia rotunda.) E. भूमि earth, and चम्पक Michelia.
भूमिज: भूमिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or produced of or on the earth. m. (-जः) 1 The planet MARS. 2 Hell. f. (-जा) SĪTĀ, the wife of RĀMA. E. भूमि earth, and ज born.
भूमिजम्बु: भूमिजम्बु f. (-म्बुः-म्बू) A tree, (Premna herbacea.) E. भूमि earth, and जम्बु Eugenia; also with कन् added to either form, भूमिजम्बुका, and भूमिजम्बूका.
भूमिजीविन्: भूमिजीविन् m. (-वी) The Vaiśya or Hindu of the third, or agricultural and mercantile tribe. E. भूमि the earth, and जीविन् who gets a livelihood.
भूमिदान: भूमिदान n. (-नं) Donation of landed property. E. भूमि, and दान gift.
भूमिदेव: भूमिदेव m. (-वः) A Brahman. E. भूमि the earth, and देव a divinity.
भूमिप: भूमिप m. (-पः) A prince, a sovereign. E. भमि the earth, and प who protects.
भूमिपक्ष: भूमिपक्ष m. (-क्षः) A horse of a good breed. E. भूमि the earth, and पक्ष part or side.
भूमिपति: भूमिपति m. (-तिः) A king. E. भूमि, and पति master.
भूमिपतित्व: भूमिपतित्व n. (-त्वं) Princedom, sovereignty. E. त्व added to the last.
भूमिभृत्: भूमिभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 A king. 2 A mountain. E. भूमि, and भृत् who nourishes.
भूमिपिशाच: भूमिपिशाच m. (-चः) The palmyra tree, (Borassus flabelliformis.) E. भूमि earth, पिशाच goblin.
भूमिमण्डा: भूमिमण्डा f. (-ण्डा) Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.) E. भूमि the earth, मडि to ornament, aff. अच्.
भूमिरक्षक: भूमिरक्षक m. (-कः) A horse of a good breed. E. भूमि the earth, रक्ष to preserve, aff. वुन्; it is also written भूमिरक्ष, and भूमिपक्ष.
भूमिलाभ: भूमिलाभ m. (-भः) Death, dying. E. भूमि earth, लाभ acquisition.
भूमिलेपन: भूमिलेपन n. (-नं) Cow-dung. E. भूमि earth, and लेपन plastering; the clay floors of houses, temples, &c. being usually kneaded up with this article.
भूमिवर्द्धन: भूमिवर्द्धन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Increasing or adding to the earth. mn. (-नः-नं) A corpse. E. भूमि the earth, and वर्द्धन increasing.
भूमिशय: भूमिशय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sleeping on the ground. E. भूमि, and शी to sleep, श aff.
भूमिष्ठ: भूमिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Standing or staying on the earth. E. भूमि, and स्थ who or what stays.
भूमिसम्भव: भूमिसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in or of the earth. f. (-वा) SĪTĀ. E. भूमि the earth, and सम्भव born: see भूपुत्त्री.
भूमिस्पृश्: भूमिस्पृश् m. (-स्पृक्) 1 A man, man, mankind. 2 The Vaiśya or Hindu of the third tribe, the cultivator or trader. 3 A thief, one who creeps along the ground to carry off his plunder. 4 A blind man. 5 A cripple, a lame man. E. भूमि the earth, the ground, and स्पृश who touches, from स्पृश, with क्विप् aff.
भूमीन्द्र: भूमीन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A king, a sovereign. E. भूमि earth, and इन्द्र chief.
भूम्यामलकी: भूम्यामलकी f. (-की) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. भूमि the earth, आमलकी a myrobalan; also भूम्यासनी f. (-नी)
भूय: भूय n. (-यं) Abstract state, but used in composition, as ब्रह्मभूय the state of BRAHMA, or identification with BRAHMA, becoming of the same nature, &c. E. भू to be, aff. क्यप्.
भूयस्: भूयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Much, many. ind. Frequently, repeatedly, again. 2 Exceeding, over, above. E. बहु much, इयसुन् affix of the superlative, भू substituted for बहु, and the ई of the aff. rejected; also with इष्ठन् aff. भूयिष्ठ.
भूयिष्ठ: भूयिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Many, very many, much, most: see the last.
भूरि: भूरि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Much, many. ind. Much, exceeding. m. (-रिः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 BRAHMĀ. 3 ŚIVA. 4 A day. n. (-रि) Gold. E. भू to be, क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.
भूरिज्: भूरिज् f. (-रिक्) The earth. E. भृ to support, इजि Uṇādi aff., and ऋ changed to ऊर.
भूरिधामन्: भूरिधामन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) 1 Splendid, bright. 2 Illustrious. E. भूरि, and धामन् splendor.
भूरिफेना: भूरिफेना f. (-ना) A plant, commonly Carmaghās. E. भूरि much, and फेन cuttle-fish bone.
भूरिमाय: भूरिमाय m. (-यः) A shakal. E. भूरि much, माय deceit.
भूरिलाभ: भूरिलाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Very profitable or beneficial. n. (-भं) Great gain. E. भूरि, and लाभ gain.
भूरिशस्: भूरिशस् ind. Manifold, many by many. E. भूरि many, शस् aff.
भूरुण्डी: भूरुण्डी f. (-ण्डी) A sort of sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.) E. भू the earth, रुह to grow; or रुद्ध to oppose, क aff., deriv. irr.
भूरुह: भूरुह m. (-हः) A tree. E. भू the earth, and रुह what grows.
भूर्ज: भूर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) The Bhoj or Bhojpatra, a tree growing in the snowy mountains, a kind of birch; the bark is used for writing on, and very generally for Hooka snakes. E. भू the earth, and ऊर्ज्ज to be strong or hardy, aff. अच्.
भूर्ज्ज: भूर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) The Bhoj or Bhojpatra, a tree growing in the snowy mountains, a kind of birch; the bark is used for writing on, and very generally for Hooka snakes. E. भू the earth, and ऊर्ज्ज to be strong or hardy, aff. अच्.
भूर्ज्जकण्डक: भूर्ज्जकण्डक m. (-कः) A man of one of the inferior or mixed classes, sprung from an outcast Brahman by a woman of the same tribe. E. भूर्ज्ज the Bhoj, and कण्ठ the throat, कन् added.
भूर्जपत्र: भूर्ज्जपत्र m. (-त्रः) The Bhojpatra : see भूर्ज्ज. E. भूर्ज्ज as above, पत्र a leaf.
भूर्ज्जपत्र: भूर्ज्जपत्र m. (-त्रः) The Bhojpatra : see भूर्ज्ज. E. भूर्ज्ज as above, पत्र a leaf.
भूर्णि: भूर्णि f. (-र्णिः) 1 The earth. 2 A desart, a country ill supplied with water. E. भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. नि, deriv. irr.
भूर्लोक: भूर्लोक m. (-कः) The earth, the habitation of mortals. E. भूः the earth, and लोक the world.
भूलता: भूलता f. (-ता) A worm, an earthworm. E. भू the earth, लता a creeping plant.
भूशक्र: भूशक्र m. (-क्रः) A king. E. भू the earth, and शक्र INDRA.
भूशुद्धि: भूशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Purifying the ground by sweeping, burning, &c. E. भू, and शुद्धि purification.
भूश्रवस्: भूश्रवस् m. (-वाः) An ant or mole hill. E. भू the earth, and श्रु to exude, असुन् aff.
भूष: भूष r. 1st and 10th cls. (भूषति भूषयति) To decorate, to adorn.
भूषण: भूषण n. (-णं) Ornament, embellishment. E. भूष to adorn, aff. युच्.
भूषयितव्य: भूषयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be decorated or ornamented. E. भष, and तव्य aff.; also भूषणीय, &c.
भूषा: भूषा f. (-षा) Adorning, decorating with trinkets, jewels, &c. E. भूष to adorn, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
भूषित: भूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Adorned, decorated, dressed. E. भूष to adorn, aff. क्त.
भूष्णु: भूष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Being, existing. 2 Being well, faring well. E. भू to be, स्नु aff.
भूसुत: भूसुत m. (-तः) The planet MARS. f. (-ता) SĪTĀ the wife of RĀMA. E. भू the earth, and सुत the offspring.
भूस्तृण: भूस्तृण n. (-णं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schænanthus.) E. भू the earth, तृण grass, and सुट् augment.
भूस्पृश्: भूस्पृश् m. (-स्पृक) Man, a man, mankind. E. भू the earth, and स्पृश् who touches: see भूमिस्पृश्.
भूस्वर्ग: भूस्वर्ग m. (-र्गः) The mountain Sumeru. E. भू, and स्वर्ग paradise; a heaven on earth.
भूस्वामिन्: भूस्वामिन् m. (-मी) A landlord, a landholder.
भृ: भृ(ञ्) भृञ् r. 1st cl. (भरति-ते) (डु ञ्) डुभृञ् r. 3rd cl. (विभर्त्ति विभृते) 1 To nourish, to cherish, to foster, to maintain. 2 To fill. 3 To hold or support.
भृकुंस: भृकुंस m. (-सः) A male actor or dancer in female apparel. E. भ्रु an eye-brow, कुसि to speak, aff. अच्, रु changed to ऋ; also with कन् added भृकुंसक, and रु unchanged भ्रकुंस; also from कुशि, भृकुंश, &c.
भृकुटि: भृकुटि f. (-टिः-टी) A frown, a contraction of the brows. E. भ्रु the eye-brow, कुट to be or make crooked, aff. कि, and ङीप् optionally added, भृ substituted for भ्रु; otherwise भ्रुकुटि, भ्रुकुटी, &c.
भृगु: भृगु m. (-गुः) 1 The name of a celebrated Muni, and one of the ten Brahmādikas or Prajāpatis, the sons of BRAHMĀ, and first created of beings. 2 A name of ŚIVA. 3 ŚUKRA, the regent of VENUS. 4 A precipice. 5 Table land, the level summit of a mountain. 6 The Ṛṣi JAMADAGNI, the father of PARAŚURĀMA and grandson of the Muni BHṚGU. E. भ्रस्ज to fry (in religious fervour), Uṇādi aff. कु; र is changed to ऋ, the स rejected, and the final ज becomes ग.
भृगुपति: भृगुपति m. (-तिः) The hero, and Avatar PARAŚURĀMA. E. भृगु implying the race of BHṚGU or JAMADAGNI, and पति master, chief.
भृगुसुत: भृगुसुत m. (-तः) 1 ŚUKRA or VENUS, the son of the Muni BHṚGU, and the preceptor of the DAITYAS. 2 The hero PARAŚURĀMA. E. भृगु the saint BHṚGU, or his descendant JAMADAGNI, and सुत the son.
भृगूणाम्पति: भृगूणाम्पति m. (-तिः) The first of the three incarnations of VIṢṆU called RĀMAS; PARAŚURĀMA the son of JAMADAGNI. E. भृगु in the sixth case plural, and पति master, chief of the BHṚGUS or race of BHṚGU.
भृङ्ग: भृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A large black bee, the humble bee. 2 A catamite, a libertine, a lecher. 3 A plant, (Eclipta or Verbesina prostrata.) 4 A wasp, either the common kind, or the Vespa solitaria. 5 A golden vase. 6 The fork-tailed shrike, (Lanius cærulescens.) 7 A bird, apparently a sort of shrike different from the preceding. n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Woody cassia. 2 Talc. E. भृ to nourish, गन् Uṇādi aff., and नुट् augment.
भृङ्गक: भृङ्गक m. (-कः) A bird, a sort of shrike, (Lanius malabaricus.) E. कन्, added to the last.
भृङ्गज: भृङ्गज n. (-जं) Aloe wood or Agallochum.
भृङ्गपर्णिका: भृङ्गपर्णिका f. (-का) Small or Guzerati cardamoms.
भृङ्गरजस्: भृङ्गरजस् m. (-जाः) Eclipta prostrata: see the next.
भृङ्गराज: भृङ्गराज m. (-जः) 1 A spreading shrub, (Eclipta or Verbesina prostrata, or perhaps more properly, Verbesina scandens.) 2 A sort of bird, apparently the variety of shrike termed Malabar, (Lanius malabaricus). 3 The humble bee. 4 A particular sacrifice. E. भृङ्ग a bee, and राज to shine, aff. अच्; or with रजस dust, भृङ्गरजस्; and with राजन् shining, ruling, भृङ्गराजन् m. (-जा)
भृङ्गरिट: भृङ्गरिट m. (-टः) One of ŚIVA'S door-keepers. E. भृङ्ग a bee, रट to speak or make a noise, to buzz, aff. अच्, and the penultimate changed to इ; also with इन् aff., and the penultimate long or short, the word is read भृङ्गरिटि, भृङ्गरीट, and भृङ्गरीटि.
भृङ्गरोल: भृङ्गरोल m. (-लः) A wasp. E. भृङ्ग a bee, रु to cry, लच् aff.
भृङ्गसोदर: भृङ्गसोदर m. (-रः) A plant, apparently a variety of Eclipta or Verbesina.
भृङ्गार: भृङ्गार m. (-रः) 1 A golden vase, especially used at royal ceremonials. 2 A shrub, (Eclipta prostrata, &c. see भृङ्गराज.) n. (-रं) 1 Cloves. 2 Gold. f. (-री) A cricket. E. भृ to contain, (water, &c.) आरन् Uṇādi aff., and गुक् augment; or भृङ्ग a bee, and अरि an enemy; fem. form.
भृङ्गारिका: भृङ्गारिका f. (-का) A cricket. E. भृङ्ग a bee, अरि an enemy, and कन् aff.
भृङ्गावली: भृङ्गावली f. (-ली) A line or flight of bees. E. भृङ्ग, and आवली a row.
भृङ्गिन्: भृङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) One of ŚIVA'S chamberlains. E. भृङ्ग a bee, इनि aff.
भृङ्गीफल: भृङ्गीफल m. (-लः) The hog-plum: see आम्रातक.
भृङ्गीश: भृङ्गीश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. भृङ्गी the attendant of the deity, and ईश master.
भृज: भृज(ई)भृजी r. 1st cl. (भर्जते) To parch, to fry.
भृज्जन: भृज्जन n. (-नं) A frying pan. E. भ्रस्ज to fry, Uṇādi aff. क्युन्, and the root changed.
भृत: भृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Hired, paid, maintained. 2 Cherished, supported. 3 Filled. 4 Having, being possessed of, or endowed with. m. (-तः) 1 A servant. 2 A hired labourer. E. भृ to nourish, aff. क्त.
भृतक: भृतक m. (-कः) 1 A hired labourer. 2 A servant. E. भृत hired, कन् added.
भृतकाध्यापक: भृतकाध्यापक m. (-कः) A hired teacher, one who gives instructions for pay. E. भृतक, and अध्यापक a teacher.
भृतकाध्यापित: भृतकाध्यापित m. (-तः) A student who pays his teacher. E. भृतक, and अध्यापित instructed.
भृतभूति: भृतभूति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 Prosperous, powerful, exalted. 2 Smeared with ashes. E. भृत possessed, and भूति power, &c.
भृतरन्ध्र: भृतरन्ध्र mfn. (-न्ध्रः-न्ध्रा-न्ध्रं) Filled up, (as a hole or depression.) E. भृत, and रन्ध्र a hole.
भृति: भृति f. (-तिः) 1 Wages, hire. 2 Capital, principal. 3 Nourishment, maintenance. E. भृ to nourish, aff. क्तिन्.
भृतिभुज्: भृतिभुज् m. (-भुक्) A hired labourer or servant. E. भृति hire, भुज् to eat, aff. क्विप्.
भृत्य: भृत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) To be nourished or maintained. m. (-त्यः) 1 A dependant. 2 A servant, a slave. f. (-त्या) Hire, wages. E. भृ to nourish, aff. क्यप्, with तुक् augment.
भृत्यत्व: भृत्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Servitude, service, dependance. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, भृत्यता.
भृत्यध्यापन: भृत्यध्यापन n. (-नं) Teaching, (especially the Vedas,) for hire. E. भृति, and अध्यापन instructing.
भृत्यभरण: भृत्यभरण n. (-णं) Maintaining or cherishing dependants, servants, &c. E. भृत्य, and भरण nourishing.
भृत्यभर्तृ: भृत्यभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A master of a family taking good care of his dependants. E. भृत्य, and भर्त्तृ who nourishes.
भृत्यभर्त्तृ: भृत्यभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A master of a family taking good care of his dependants. E. भृत्य, and भर्त्तृ who nourishes.
भृत्यवात्सल्य: भृत्यवात्सल्य n. (-ल्यं) Kindness to dependants or servants. E. भृत्य, and वात्सल्य tenderness.
भृत्यविनिवेश: भृत्यविनिवेश m. (-शः) Fixing or planting firmly. E. भृत्य, and विनिवेश placing.
भृत्यवृत्ति: भृत्यवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Maintenance of servants or dependants. E. भृत्य, and वृत्ति practice.
भृत्यशालिन्: भृत्यशालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Having many servants. E. भृत्य, and शालिन् possessing.
भृमि: भृमि m. (-मिः) 1 A whirlwind, a hurricane, a high wind. 2 An eddy, a whirlpool. E. भ्रम to turn round, इन् Uṇādi aff., and the semivowel changed to its congener.
भृश: भृश(इर्, उ,) इर् भृशु r. 4th cl. (भृश्यति) To fall, to fall down, literally or figuratively, as from a height, from dignity or virtue, &c.
भृश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Much, exceeding. n. ad. (-शं) Much, exceedingly. ind. (भृशम्) 1 Much. 2 Eminently, superiorly, better. 3 Repeatedly. 4 Beautifully. E. भृश to fall, aff. क.
भृशस्विद्: भृशस्विद् mfn. (-स्विद्) Perspiring violently. E. भृश, and स्विद् to sweat, क्विन् aff.
भृष्ट: भृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Fried. E. भ्रस्ज to fry, aff. क्त, the vowel substituted for the semivowel.
भृष्टान्न: भृष्टान्न n. (-न्नं) Rice boiled, and then fried. E. भृष्ट fried, अन्न boiled rice.
भृष्टि: भृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Frying. 2 An uninhabited or lonely garden, &c. E. भ्रस्ज to fry, aff. क्तिन्, the semivowel changed to ऋ.
भॄ: भॄ r. 9th cl. (भृणाति) 1 To blame or censure. 2 To nourish, to maintain, to support. 3 To hold. 4 To fry.
भेक: भेक m. (-कः) 1 A frog. 2 A cloud. f. (-की) 1 The female of the frog, or a small frog. 2 A kind of creeper, (Hydrocotyle Asiatica.) E. भी to fear, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
भेकपर्णी: भेकपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A creeper, (Hydrocotyle Asiatica.) E. भेक a frog, and पर्ण a leaf; resembling the animal.
भेकभुज्: भेकभुज् m. (-क्) A serpent, a snake. E. भेक, and भुज who eats.
भेड: भेड m. (-डः) 1 A ram, a sheep. 2 A raft, a float. 3 The name of a saint. f. (-डी) A ewe. E. भिल a Sautra root, to separate, aff. अच्, and ल changed to ड; also with कन् added, भेडक.
भेतव्य: भेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be feared or apprehended. E. भी to fear, तव्य aff.
भेत्तृ: भेत्तृ mfn. (-त्ता-त्त्री-त्तृ) Who or what divides, disunites, &c. m. (-त्ता) 1 A divider or separator. 2 A factious or seditious man, a traitor, or one who secretly corresponds with an enemy, &c. E. भिद to divide, to sow dissension, aff. तृच्.
भेद: भेद m. (-दः) 1 Dividing, separating. 2 Tearing, rending, breaking, &c. 3 Distinction, kind, sort, species, difference. 4 Disunion, disagreement. 5 Sowing dissension, breaking the unanimity of confederates, one of the means of success against an opponent. E. भिद to divide, aff. घञ्.
भेदक: भेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A breaker, who or what breaks or divides. m. (-कः) A mischief-maker. E. भिद to break, ण्वुल् aff.
भेदकर: भेदकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Separating, disuniting. 2 Causing dissension. E. भेद, and कर who or what makes.
भेदन: भेदन n. (-नं) Dividing, separating, literally or figuratively, as tearing, breaking, specifying, discriminating, causing separation or dissension, &c. E. भिद to break, aff. ल्युट्.
भेदप्रत्यय: भेदप्रत्यय m. (-यः) Belief in the reality of the multiform appearances of the world, in opposition to the doctrine that every thing is GOD. E. भेद difference, प्रत्यय faith.
भेदित: भेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Divided, separated, literally or figuratively. E. भिद to break, aff. क्त; also भिन्न.
भेदिन्: भेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Who or what divides, &c. 2 Having a distinction or division. m. (-दी) The ratan. E. भिद to divide, धिनुण् aff. or भेद sort, &c. and इनि aff.
भेदुर: भेदुर n. (-रं) The thunderbolt of INDRA. E. भिद to split, (rocks, &c.) उरच् aff.; also भिदुर, and भेदिर.
भेद्य: भेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 To be broken. 2 To be divided, pierced, cut, &c. 3 To be disconcerted or deterred. 4 To be set at variance or disunited. E. भिद to break, यत् aff.
भेन: भेन m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. E. भ a star, a planet, and इन a master.
भेरि: भेरि mf. (-रिः-री) A kettle drum. E. भी to fear, to cause fear, Uṇādi aff. कीन्; otherwise, रन् aff., and ङीप् added.
भेरुण्ड: भेरुण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Formidable, fearful. f. (-ण्डा) One of the Yakṣiṇīs, or female attendants on DURGĀ. m. (-ण्डः) A particular deity; a form of ŚIVA, according to the Tantras. n. (-ण्डं) Conception, impregnation. E. भी to fear, deriv. irr.; it is sometimes read भेरण्ड.
भेल: भेल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Ignorant, unwise, foolish. 2 Fearful, timid. 3 Unsteady, figuratively or literally. m. (-लः) 1 A raft, a float. 2 The name of a Muni, the supposed author of some medical works. E. भी to fear, Uṇādi aff. रन्, and the final changed to ल.
भेलक: भेलक mn. (-कः-कं) A raft, a float. E. कन् added to the preceding.
भेष: भेष(ऋ)भेषृ r. 1st cl. (भेषति-ते) 1 To fear or dread. 2 To go.
भेषज: भेषज n. (-जं) 1 A remedy, a drug, a medicament. 2 A kind of fennel, (Nigella Indica.) E. भेष here interpreted disease, जि to conquer, aff. ड; or भिषज् a root of a particular class, and अच् aff.
भेषजाङ्ग: भेषजाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The vehicle or medium in which medicine is administered, as water gruel, &c. E. भेषज a drug, and अङ्ग a limb or part.
भैक्ष: भैक्ष n. (-क्षं) 1 Alms, what is collected by begging. 2 Begging, mendicancy. E. भिक्षा alms, given and received, aff. अण्; also भैक्ष्य.
भैक्षचरण: भैक्षचरण n. (-णं) Plying for alms, begging. E. भैक्ष, and चरण going.
भैक्षचर्या: भैक्षचर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Begging, collecting alms. E. भैक्ष, and चर्य्या practice.
भैक्षचर्य्या: भैक्षचर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Begging, collecting alms. E. भैक्ष, and चर्य्या practice.
भैक्षजीविका: भैक्षजीविका f. (-का) Living upon alms, begging, mendicancy. E. भैक्ष aggregate alms, जीविका livelihood.
भैक्षभुज्: भैक्षभुज् m. (-भुक्) A mendicant. E. भैक्ष alms, and भुज् who subsists; also भैक्षाशिन्, भिक्षाशिन्, &c.
भैक्षाशिन्: भैक्षाशिन् m. (-शी) A mendicant. E. भैक्ष, and आशिन् who eats.
भैक्षाहार: भैक्षाहार m. (-रः) A mendicant, one living on charity. E. भैक्ष, and आहार food.
भैक्ष्य: भैक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) Mendicity, begging. E. भिक्षा, and यञ् aff.
भैरव: भैरव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Formidable, horrible, terrific. n. (-वं) Horror, the property of exciting terror. m. (-वः) 1 A name of ŚIVA, but more especially an inferior manifestation or form of the deity, eight of which are called by the common name Bhairava, and are severally termed ASITĀṄGA, RURU, CAṆḌA, KRODHA, UNMATTA, KUPATI, BHĪṢAṆA, and SAṂHĀRA, all alluding to terrific properties of mind or body. 2 The name of a river. 3 A musical mode; that which is calculated to excite emotions of terror. f. (-वी) A name or form of DURGĀ. E. भीरु fearful, aff. अण्.
भैरवकारक: भैरवकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Formidable. E. भैरव, and कारक what causes.
भैषज: भैषज m. (-जः) A sort of quail. n. (-जं) A medicament. E. भिषज a medicament, and अण् referential or pleonastic aff.
भैषज्य: भैषज्य n. (-ज्यं) A drug, a medicament. E. भैषज the same, ञय pleonastic aff.
भो: भो ind. A vocative particle. E. भा to shine, डो aff., more commonly भोम्.
भोक्तव्य: भोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be used or enjoyed. 2 To be eaten. E. भुज to eat, &c., तव्य aff.
भोक्तृ: भोक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) 1 Enjoying, an enjoyer. 2 An eater. m. (-क्ता) A husband. E. भुज to enjoy, &c., aff. तृच्.
भोक्तृत्व: भोक्तृत्व n. (-त्वं) Possession, enjoyment. E. त्व added to the last.
भोक्ष्यमाण: भोक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being about to eat. E. भुज to eat, and शानच् aff., here of the future tense.
भोग: भोग m. (-गः) 1 Pleasure, enjoyment. 2 Wealth. 3 Nourishing, cherishing. 4 Eating. 5 A snake's body. 6 A snake's expanded hood. 7 Hire. 8 The hire of dancing girls or courtezans. 9 A snake. 10 An army in column. 11 (In arithmetic,) The numerator of a fraction. E. भुज to eat, &c., aff. घञ्.
भोगगुच्छ: भोगगुच्छ n. (-च्छं) Price paid to harlots.
भोगगृह: भोगगृह m. (-हः) The inner or private apartment, the haram. E. भोग enjoyment, and गृह a house.
भोगपति: भोगपति m. (-तिः) 1 A viceroy, a governor. 2 A person having possession or usufruct. E. भोग enjoyment, and पति master.
भोगपाल: भोगपाल m. (-लः) A groom. E. भोग pleasure, and पाल who nourishes.
भोगपिशाचिका: भोगपिशाचिका f. (-का) Hunger. E. भोग eating, पिशाचिका an imp.
भोगभूमि: भोगभूमि f. (-मिः) Svarga or paradise. E. भोग enjoyment, and भूमि soil.
भोगभृतक: भोगभृतक m. (-कः) A servant or slave, who works for maintenance only. E. भोग enjoyment, and भृत्तक a hireling.
भोगलाभ: भोगलाभ m. (-भः) Interest or profit made by the use of any thing pledged. E. भोग enjoyment, and लाभ gain.
भोगवत्: भोगवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Enjoying, having enjoyment. 2 Delightful, pleasurable, yielding enjoyment. m. (-वान्) 1 A snake. 2 Dancing, acting. 3 Singing. f. (-ती) 1 The capital of the Nāgas, or serpents. 2 The Ganges of the lower regions. E. भोग enjoyment, aff. मतुप्.
भोगसद्मन्: भोगसद्मन् n. (-द्म) The inner apartment, the haram. E. भोग pleasure, and सद्मन् a dwelling.
भोगस्थान: भोगस्थान n. (-नं) 1 The body as the seat, of sensual enjoyment. 2 A haram, &c. E. भोग enjoyment, and स्थान place.
भोगार्ह: भोगार्ह n. (-र्हं) Wealth, property. E. भोग, and अर्ह fit for.
भोगावली: भोगावली f. (-ली) Praise, eulogium, the panegyric of professional encomiasts or bards. E. भोग enjoyment, आवली a row or range.
भोगावास: भोगावास m. (-सः) The haram, the inner or women's apartment. E. भोग enjoyment, आवास abode.
भोगिक: भोगिक m. (-कः) A horse-keeper, a groom. E. भोग pleasure, ठक् aff.
भोगिकान्त: भोगिकान्त m. (-न्तः) Air, wind. E. भोगि a snake, and कान्त friend.
भोगिन्: भोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Enjoying, possessing, an enjoyer, &c. m. (-गी) 1 A snake. 2 A king, a prince. 3 A barber. 4 The head man of a village. 5 A person who accumulates money for a particular expenditure. f. (-नी) 1 The capital of the Nāgas. 2 A royal concubine. E. भोग enjoyment, aff. इनि.
भोगिवल्लभ: भोगिवल्लभ n. (-भं) Sandal. E. भोगिन् a snake, वल्लभ beloved.
भोगीन्द्र: भोगीन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The serpent ANANTA. E. भोगि a snake, इन्द्र a sovereign; also भोगीश.
भोग्य: भोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) To be enjoyed. n. (-ग्यं) 1 Wealth. 2 Grain. f. (-ग्या) A whore. E. भुज to enjoy, aff. ण्यत्.
भोज: भोज m. (-जः) 1 A country, Patna and Bhāgalpur. 2 The name of a sovereign of Oujein, who is supposed to have flourished about the end of the tenth century; he was a celebrated patron of learned men, and the nine gems, or poets, and philosophers, are often ascribed to his æra. 3 A cowherd. E. भुज to enjoy, aff. अच्, and the final consonant unchanged.
भोजकट: भोजकट m. (-टः) The country of Bhoja, the present Bhojpur, or the vicinity of Patna and Bhāgalpur. E. भोज the same, and कट to go, aff. अच्.
भोजन: भोजन n. (-नं) 1 Food. 2 Eating. E. भुज to eat, aff. ल्युट्.
भोजनविशेष: भोजनविशेष m. (-षः) Choice food, a delicacy. E. भोजन, and विशेष superior sort.
भोजनव्यग्र: भोजनव्यग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Straitened for food. E. भोजन, and व्यग्र anxious.
भोजनाधिकार: भोजनाधिकार m. (-रः) Commissariat, stewardship, charge of provender. E. भोजन, and अधिकार superintendence.
भोजनीय: भोजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be enjoyed. 2 To be eaten. n. (-यं) Food. E. भुज to enjoy, aff. अनीयर्.
भोजयित्वा: भोजयित्वा ind. Having fed. E. भुज to eat, causal v., क्त्वा aff.
भोजाधिप: भोजाधिप m. (-पः) A name of KARṆA, the half brother of the Pāṇḍus. E. भोज Bhāgalpur, and अधिप sovereign.
भोज्य: भोज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) To be eaten, edible. n. (-ज्यं) Food. E. भुज to eat, ण्यत् aff., and the final unchanged.
भोज्यसम्भव: भोज्यसम्भव m. (-वः) Chyle, the primary juice of the body. E. भोज्य food, and सम्भव production.
भोटाङ्ग: भोटाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A country, probably Butan.
भोभो: भोभो ind. A particle of calling or addressing. E. भो as above, repeated.
भोलि: भोलि m. (-लिः) A camel. E. भा to shine, उलिच् aff.
भोस्: भोस् ind. 1 A particle of calling or addressing. 2 An interrogative particle. E. भा to shine, aff. डोस्.
भौत: भौत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) 1 Demoniac, relating to sprites or goblins. 2 Elemental. 3 Relating to existing beings. m. (-तः) 1 An attendant upon idols. 2 A worshipper of sprites and goblins. f. (-ती) Night. E. भूत a goblin, &c., aff. अण्.
भौतिक: भौतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating or appertaining to evil spirits. 2 Elemental. 3 Existent. m. (-कः) ŚIVA. E. भूत a sprite, &c., and टक् aff.
भौम: भौम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Earthly, terrestrial, produced in or relating to the earth. m. (-मः) 1 The planet MARS. 2 Hell. 3 Ambergris. f. (-मी) A name of SĪTĀ. E. भूमि the earth, and अण् aff.
भौमरत्न: भौमरत्न n. (-त्नं) Coral. E. भौम, and रत्न a gem.
भौमिक: भौमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Earthly, terrestrial. E. भूमि, and ठञ् aff.
भौरिक: भौरिक m. (-कः) The superintendant of gold, the treasurer. E. भूरि gold, aff. ठञ्.
भ्रंश: भ्रंश(उ,)भ्रंशु r. 4th cl. (भ्रंश्यति) To fall down; also भ्रंस.
भ्रंश m. (-शः) 1 Falling, declining from a height, or from propriety. 2 Falling from or off. E. भ्रंश to fall, aff. अच्.
भ्रंस: भ्रंस(उ,)भ्रंसु r. 1st cl. (भ्रंसते) To fall down.
भ्रकुंस: भ्रकुंस m. (-सः) An actor wearing female apparel. E. भ्र for भ्रू the eye-brow, and कुशि or कुसि to speak, aff. अच्; hence also भ्रकुंश, भ्रूकुंस, &c.
भ्रकुटि: भ्रकुटि f. (-टिः-टी) A frown. E. भ्र for भ्रू the eye-brow, कुट to curve, aff. इन्; also भ्रुकुटि, &c.
भ्रम: भ्रम(उ,)भ्रमु r. 1st cl. (भ्रमति भ्रम्यति) 1 To turn round, to move circularly. 2 To be unsteady or unfixed. 3 To roam, to wander; it is also figuratively applicable to mental unsteadiness, as to err, to wander, to be ignorant or mistaken, &c. With परि, To wander about. With वि, To play, to wanton. With सम्, 1 To hurry. 2 To honour.

भ्रम m. (-मः) 1 Whirling, going round. 2 Straying, roaming. 3 Error, ignorance, mistake, misapprehension. 4 A whirlpool, an eddy. 5 A drain, a water-course. 6 A lathe, a potter's wheel, &c. E. भ्रम to go round, aff. अप्.
भ्रमण: भ्रमण n. (-णं) 1 Whirling, going round. 2 Wandering, literally or figuratively. f. (-णी) 1 A leech. 2 A sort of game, performed by women for the amusement of a lover or husband. E. भ्रम to go round, aff. ल्युट्.
भ्रमत्: भ्रमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) 1 Going round, whirling, revolving. 2 Roving. 3 Erring. E. भ्रम to turn round, शतृ aff.
भ्रमत्कुटी: भ्रमत्कुटी f. (-टी) An umbrella, a concave mat carried on the head for that purpose, &c. E. भ्रमत्, and कुटी a house.
भ्रमर: भ्रमर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) What whirls or goes round. m. (-रः) 1 A large black bee. 2 A lecher, a lover. n. (-रं) Vertigo, epilepsy. E. भ्रम to go round, aff. करन्.
भ्रमरक: भ्रमरक m. (-कः) 1 Hair curled upon the forehead. 2 A bee. 3 A ball for playing with. 4 A whirlpool. E. भ्रमर a bee, &c., कन् aff.
भ्रमरकीट: भ्रमरकीट m. (-टः) A sort of wasp, that builds a solitary nest in the angles of walls, doors, &c., (Vespa solitaria.) E. भ्रमर a bee, and कीट an insect.
भ्रमरप्रिय: भ्रमरप्रिय m. (-यः) A sort of Kadamba tree. E. भ्रमर a bee, and प्रिय beloved.
भ्रमरविलसिता: भ्रमरविलसिता f. (-ता) A species of the Triṣṭubh metre.
भ्रमरालक: भ्रमरालक m. (-कः) Hair curled upon the forehead. E. भ्रमर a bee, and अलक a curl.
भ्रमासक्त: भ्रमासक्त m. (-क्तः) An armourer, a sword-cleaner, a knifegrinder. E. भ्रस a turning instrument, a grindstone, and आसक्त diligent.
भ्रमि: भ्रमि f. (-मिः) 1 Whirling, going round. 2 Error, blunder, mistake. 3 A lathe, a potter's wheel. 4 A whirlpool. E. भ्रम to turn round, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
भ्रमिन्: भ्रमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिणी-मि) Whirling, going round or about. E. भ्रम to go round, aff. घिनुण्.
भ्रश: भ्रश(उ,)भ्रशु r. 4th cl. (भ्रश्यति) To fall down; also भृश and भ्रंश.
भ्रष्ट: भ्रष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Fallen, lost. 2 Vicious, depraved, fallen from virtue. 3 Fried, parched. E. भ्रंश to fall, or भ्रस्ज to fry, क्त aff.
भ्रष्टराज्य: भ्रष्टराज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Deposed, deprived of a kingdom. E. भ्रष्ट, and राज्य principality.
भ्रस्ज: भ्रस्ज(औ)औभ्रस्ज r. 6th cl. (भ्रज्जति-ते) To broil or fry.
भ्राज: भ्राज(टु, ऋ,) टुभ्राजृ r. 1st cl. (भ्राजते) To shine.
भ्राजक: भ्राजक n. (-कं) Bile, the bilious humour. E. भ्राज to shine, aff. ण्वुन्.
भ्राजथु: भ्राजथु f. (-थुः) Brilliance, splendour, beauty. E. भ्राज to shine, अथुच् aff.
भ्राजथुमत्: भ्राजथुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Splendid. 2 Beautiful. E. भ्राजथु, and मतुप् aff.
भ्राजिष्णु: भ्राजिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Elegant, splendid, radiant in ornament and vesture. E. भ्राज to shine, aff. इष्णुच्.
भ्रातृ: भ्रातृ m. (-ता) A brother, a uterine brother. Dual only, (-रौ) Brother and sister. E. भ्राज to shine, Uṇādi aff. तृच्, and the radical final rejected.
भ्रातृक: भ्रातृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Fraternal, brotherly, of or belonging to a brother. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and ठञ् aff.
भ्रातृज: भ्रातृज m. (-जः) A brother's son. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and ज born.
भ्रातृजाया: भ्रातृजाया f. (-या) A sister-in-law, a brother's wife. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and जाया a wife.
भ्रातृपत्नी: भ्रातृपत्नी f. (-त्नी) A brother's wife. E. भ्रातृ, and पत्नी a wife.
भ्रातृभगिन्यौ: भ्रातृभगिन्यौ dual only, (-न्यौ) A brother and sister. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and भगिनी a sister.
भ्रातृवल: भ्रातृवल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having a brother. E. भ्रतृ, and वलच् aff.
भ्रातृव्य: भ्रातृव्य m. (-व्यः) 1 A brother's son. 2 An enemy. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and तव्य aff.
भ्रातृश्वशुर: भ्रातृश्वशुर m. (-रः) A husband's elder brother. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and श्वशुर a father-in-law, (as it were.)
भ्रात्रीय: भ्रात्रीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fraternal, belonging or relating to a brother. m. (-यः) A brother's son. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and छ aff.
भ्रान्त: भ्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Whirled, revolved. 2 Blundering, mistaken. E. भ्रम to revolve, aff. क्त.
भ्रान्ति: भ्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Error, mistake, ignorance. 2 Going round, whirling, revolving. 3 Unsteadiness, locomotion. 4 Going about, wandering. E. भ्रम to go round, aff. क्तिन्, and the vowel made long.
भ्रान्तिमत्: भ्रान्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Erring, mistaking. 2 Wandering. E. भ्रान्ति, and मतुप् aff.
भ्रान्तिहर: भ्रान्तिहर m. (-रः) A counsellor, a minister. E. भ्रान्ति error, and हर who repels or removes.
भ्राम: भ्राम m. (-मः) 1 Wandering, roving. 2 Error. E. भ्रम to turn round, घञ् aff.
भ्रामक: भ्रामक m. (-कः) 1 A jackal. 2 A cheat, a rogue. 3 A sort of loadstone. 4 The sun-flower. E. भ्रम to turn round, ण्वुल् aff.
भ्रामयत्: भ्रामयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Whirling round. 2 Bewildering. E. भ्रम to wander or whirl, causal v., शतृ aff.
भ्रामर: भ्रामर n. (-रं) 1 Whirling, going round. 2 A dance performed in a ring, dancing round-about. 3 A village. 4 Epilepsy. 5 Honey. m. (-रः) A sort of loadstone. f. (-री) 1 A name of PĀRVATĪ, from her having assumed the form of a bee, in order to contend with MAHĀSURA. 2 A Yoginī, or female attendant on DURGĀ. E. भ्रमर a bee, &c. aff., अण् or अञ्.
भ्रामरिन्: भ्रामरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Whirling, revolving. 2 Epileptic, giddy. 3 Made of honey or from a bee, &c. E. भ्रामर, and इनि aff.
भ्राम्यत्: भ्राम्यत् mfn. (-म्यन्-म्यती-भ्यत्) 1 Wandering about. roving, roaming. 2 Erring, deviating. E. भ्रम to wander, शतृ aff.
भ्राश: भ्राश(टु, ऋ,)टुभ्राशृ r. 1st cl. (भ्राशते भ्राश्यते) To shine.
भ्राष्ट्र: भ्राष्ट्र mfn. (-ष्ट्रः-ष्ट्री-ष्ट्रं) Fried in a pan. mn. (ष्ट्रः-ष्ट्रं) A frying pan. E. भ्रस्ज to fry, Uṇādi aff. ष्ट्रन्; and in the attributive, अण् added.
भ्री: भ्री r. 9th cl. (भ्रीणाति भ्रिणीते) 1 To fear. 2 To hold. 3 To cherish, to maintain or support.
भ्रुकुंस: भ्रुकुंस m. (-सः) An actor in female apparel. E. भ्रु for भ्रू an eyebrow, कुसि or कुशि to shine or speak, aff. अच्; hence also भ्रुकुंश, भ्रूकुंस, &c.
भ्रुकुटि: भ्रुकुटि f. (-टिः-टी) A frown. E. भ्रु for भ्र an eye-brow, कुट to make crooked, इन् aff.: see भ्रूकुटि.
भ्रुड: भ्रुड r. 1st cl. (भ्रुडति) 1 To cover. 2 To collect.
भ्रू: भ्रू f. (भ्रूः) An eye-brow. E. भ्रम to turn round, Uṇādi aff. डू.
भ्रूकुंस: भ्रूकुंस m. (-सः) A male actor in female apparel. E. भ्रू the eyebrow, कुसि to speak or shine, aff. अच्; also from कुशि, भ्रूकुंश; this word is variously written भ्रुकुंश or भ्रुकुंस, भृकुंश or भृकुंस, and भ्रकुंश or भ्रकुंस.
भ्रूकुटि: भ्रूकुटि f. (-टिः-टी) A frown, a look of displeasure. E. भ्रू the brow, कुट to be curved, aff. इन्, and ङीप् optionally added; it is also written variously, like the last, and occurs भ्रुकुटि, भृकुटि, or भ्रकुटि.
भ्रूक्षेप: भ्रूक्षेप m. (-पः) A frown. E. भ्रू, and क्षेप throwing.
भ्रूण: भ्रूण r. 10th cl. (भ्रूणयते) 1 To hope, to trust. 2 To confide, to be without doubt. 3 To wish for, to desire.
भ्रूण m. (-णः) The embryo or fœtus, a child. E. भ्रूण to hope, to fear, aff. घञ्.
भ्रूणघ्न: भ्रूणघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Producing or causing abortion, who or what does so. E. भ्रूण, and घ्न what destroys.
भ्रूणहत्या: भ्रूणहत्या f. (-त्या) 1 Murder of the fœtus, procuring or causing abortion. 2 Any sin equally heinous. E. भ्रूण, and हत्या killing.
भ्रूणहन्: भ्रूणहन् mf. (-हा-घ्नी) 1 One who occasions or procures abortion. 2 The murderer of a Brahman. E. भ्रूण the embryo, (or any thing of which the death is equally heinous,) and हन् who kills.
भ्रूभङ्ग: भ्रूभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A frown. E. भ्रू the brow, भङ्ग a breaking, a bending.
भ्रेष: भ्रेष(ऋ)भ्रेषृ r. 1st cl. (भ्रेषते) To go, to move, to fear.
भ्रेष m. (-षः) 1 Deviation from rectitude, declining or falling from virtue, &c. 2 Going, proceeding. 3 Loss. E. भ्रेष to go, aff. घञ्.
भ्रेषण: भ्रेषण n. (-णं) Going, moving. E. भ्रेष to go, aff. ल्युट्.
भ्लाश: भ्लाश(टु ऋ)टु भ्लाशृ r. 1st cl. (भ्लाश्यते भ्लाशते) To shine; sometimes भ्लास.
भ्लेष: भ्लेष(ऋ)भ्लेषृ r. 1st cl. (भ्लेषति-ते) 1 To go. 2 To fear. म
